intent.raw_request: PLEASE IMPLEMENT THIS PLAN: create and publish Undertone0809/rudder-plugins as Rudder's curated Plugin catalog; extend Rudder Hub to discover native Codex Plugins and npx skills add compatible public Skill repositories; use Discover -> Plugin Detail -> Preview Skills/MCPs/Apps -> immutable Preview Install/Update -> Agent assignment or MCP setup; never execute third-party npx, install scripts, hooks, MCPs, Apps, or Skill scripts; synchronize the explicitly authorized PLUGIN.PACKAGE.001, PLUGIN.IMPORT.001, and PLUGIN.INSTALLATION.001 Product Logic contracts; include Superpowers, Marketing Skills, Vercel, Base44, Canva, Remotion, and Zotero; verify desktop/mobile light/dark UI with ego-browser; complete reviewer/verifier/final-review gates; commit and push both repositories; stop Rudder at Review Ready without releasing it.

skills_add-compatible repositories become one Skills-only Plugin and install the complete discovered Skill set; Marketing Skills exposes 49 Skills and Superpowers exposes 14 Skills.

Update Detail renders every component change present in the frozen immutable diff, labels each present item added, removed, or changed, and shows bounded Before and After execution surfaces for changed items before access expansion can be confirmed.

Codex App aliases are visible as unsupported inventory and never treated as Rudder Apps or MCP endpoints.
URL Import accepts compatible public sources while curated Discover remains manually controlled; private, SSH, and local boundaries are unchanged.
Organization isolation, package bounds, path safety, credential detection, attribution, and non-execution invariants remain enforced.
Superpowers and Marketing Skills complete Detail, install, Agent assignment, refresh continuity, and uninstall journeys; Agent bindings survive explicit updates.
Product Logic, engineering docs, public docs, API types, server behavior, UI copy, automated tests, and live evidence agree on Preview terminology and the absence of a Review product step.

Theme switch: Plugin icons request theme=light or theme=dark from the same-origin bounded icon endpoint and the header retains stable icon dimensions while loading.
